messages.subject: Legends
parts:

I would like advice to construct my tree.
I have problems to add legends to my tree, I am using the next code:

geom_point2(aes(subset =

as.numeric(sub("/.*", "", label))>=50 & !isTip),color="palevioletred1", size=2.2) +
geom_point2(aes(subset = 
as.numeric(sub(".*/", "", label))>=70 & as.numeric(sub(".*/", "", label))<=80 &
as.numeric(sub("/.*", "", label))>=50 & !isTip),color="yellow1", size=2.2) +
geom_point2(aes(subset = 
as.numeric(sub(".*/", "", label))>=60 & as.numeric(sub(".*/", "", label))<=70 &
as.numeric(sub("/.*", "", label))>=50 & !isTip),color="green1", size=2.2) +
geom_point2(aes(subset = 
as.numeric(sub(".*/", "", label))>=50 & as.numeric(sub(".*/", "", label))<=60 &
as.numeric(sub("/.*", "", label))>=50 & !isTip),color="cyan1", size=2.2) 


 
tree <- scaleClade(w,321,.006)
tree <- collapse(w, 321, "min" ,fill="gray",color='black')
tree

tree <- set_hilight_legend(w, c("red","blue"), c("clade1","clade2"), alpha = 1) +
theme(
legend.position= c(.95,.80), 
legend.title=element_blank(),
  legend.text = element_text(color = "black", size = 8, family="Arial"),
legend.key.size = unit(0.5, "cm"),
legend.key = element_blank())
tree


My problems are two: 


1.- When I add the legend for the clades (using set_hilight_legend) the axis y of my new collapsed tree is modified as if I have a non collapsed tree and adding whitespace (that would correspond to my collapsed clades)


  



2.- I do not know how add a second legend box for my node points. 
My bootstrap values also contain values of my SH-aLRT test, so my node labels look like "98.7/99.7 " (SH-aLRT/Bootstrap) and are characters for that reason I use the function sub() and make subsets. But now, I do not know how to add a second box legend due that I am working with several subsets.

Could you help me please, I'm stuck in this step. 
Thanks in advance

messages.subject: Re: Legends
parts:
I didn't reproduce problems1.
As for problems2, I'd suggest dealing with the label first.

library("ggplot2")
library("ggtree")
library("treeio")
library("tidytree")
#tree
nwk <- "test.treefile"
tree <- read.tree(nwk)
#Extract node label
bootsv <-data.frame(tree[["node.label"]])
ntip <- length(tree[["tip.label"]])
nnode <- tree[["Nnode"]]
SHaLRT <- data.frame(lapply(bootsv, function(x) as.numeric(sub("/.*", "",x))))
UFBoot <-data.frame(lapply(bootsv, function(x) as.numeric(sub(".*/", "",x))))
support <- cbind(SHaLRT, UFBoot)
colnames(support) <- c("SHaLRT", "UFBoot")
row.names(support) <- c((ntip + 1) : (ntip + nnode))
#Remove values below 50
support <- support[which(support$SHaLRT >=50 & support$UFBoot >=50),]
#cut data
support$UFBoot <- cut(as.numeric(support$UFBoot), breaks = c(50,60,70,80,90,100),right = F,include.lowest = TRUE)
#Put the results back into the tree.
tree[["node.label"]] <- support$UFBoot
#make a color list
col = c("cyan1", "green1", "yellow1", "palevioletred1", "blueviolet")
names(col) = c(1, 2, 3, 4, 5)
#plot
tree <- ggtree(tree) +
  geom_point2(aes(subset = !isTip,colour = label), size=2.2)+
  geom_tiplab(size = 2.6, align=TRUE, linesize=0.25)+
  geom_text(aes(label=node)) +
  geom_hilight(node=26, fill="red", alpha=.5) +
  geom_hilight(node=35, fill="blue", alpha=.5, extend=0.19) +
  scale_colour_manual("UFBoot(SHaLRT>=50)", #legend name
                    values = col, #legend color
                    labels = c("50<=UFBoot<60", "60<=UFBoot<70", "70<=UFBoot<80",  "80<=UFBoot<90", "90<=UFBoot<100"))  #rename key label of legend
